## Functions

### `createRealmForgeSourceCityPresentationHost({ processTable, processEntry, operatorContext, operatorScope, assertHostCurrent, })`

Trusted Desktop issuance only. Identity labels are not GPU capabilities. The original registered process, mount signal and captured operator scope remain private; retirement never saves or discards a document.

### `bindRealmForgeSourceCityStorage(storage, presentation)`

Borrow original permission-guarded storage; never own or close its backend.

### `closeRealmForgeSourceCityHost({ processTable, processEntry, app, reason = 'panel-close', close })`

Ready RealmForge only: coalesce an advisory decision and actual app cleanup while the original host/GPU authority is still usable. The caller's existing destructive close runs only after successful unmount. A refusal has no host retirement effects; forced termination and provisional mount cancellation deliberately do not use this graceful path.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
